gating: Run layers in order. Do not run a layer until every case in the layer before it passes. There is no API and no web app: unit covers every pure function and every file the generator or installer writes; cli runs the generator, the brand gates, typecheck and lint; browser is checkpoint 6's axe-core lane only, outside bun test.
conventions: Every test command runs from the repo root as `TMPDIR=/private/tmp/t-runs bun test <file>` (create the folder first).
Assert exact bytes and exact messages, never presence alone; each refusing case is proven by mutating a copy, never the committed file (R1).
Lists of templates, carriers and shells come from a glob of templates/*.html.tpl (plus brand/gallery.html.tpl from checkpoint 5), never a hand list (R7, R35).
Generator runs point AI_ENGINEERING_WEB_DIR at a scratch folder, so the older website drift stays out of the result (R37).
Install cases run against a scratch home from the existing useHome helper in tests/carriers-install.spec.ts, never the real home (R41).

browser.case: the eight templates and the gallery (glob) show zero axe-core violations for wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px and again under forced-colors: active; exit 0
browser.why_ui: Rendered contrast, accessible names and forced-colours mapping exist only after the browser computes styles and the accessibility tree.

browser.case: every tab set walked by keyboard: ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home and End move aria-selected and focus, and exactly one panel is visible; the result is reported per page
browser.why_ui: Focus movement and panel visibility need real key events and layout; the static gate only sees markup.

browser.case: at 320px no page scrolls sideways, also with the WCAG text-spacing overrides applied; reported per page
browser.why_ui: Horizontal overflow is a layout result only a rendering engine produces.

browser.case: with JavaScript disabled every tab panel is visible and no copy or filter button shows; reported per page
browser.why_ui: The no-script reading depends on CSS and script interplay that only a browser with scripting turned off shows.

browser.case: a copy of a template with a planted low-contrast pair makes the lane exit 1 and print the page, the width and the color-contrast rule
browser.why_ui: Proves B1 can fail (R1); computed contrast exists only in the browser.

not_tested: The copy button's polite status and select-the-text fallback, filter aria-pressed with its announced count, and expand-all are not asserted one by one: axe (B1) checks their names and roles, and the owner's app review judges the behaviour. Add a gallery journey to scripts/artifact-axe.ts if one breaks.
Chrome missing (one clear line, exit 1) is not automated: Playwright locates the chrome channel at a fixed install path, so it cannot be hidden from inside a test without touching the machine.
Firefox and Safari forced-colours handling of inline SVG: the lane runs Chrome only (plan note).

Whether every colour pair a component uses is declared is checked by name (U29) and by axe's rendered contrast (B1), not derived from components.css selectors, because a selector-to-pair mapper would be a second CSS engine.
The website import of components.css and the published gallery: deferred to the ai-engineering-web pull request.
Page weight over about 30 KB only informs (U45); no case fails on it.
